item.title: CSTO Secretary General Notes Danger of Europe's Militarization, Bellicose Rhetoric
item.summary: MOSCOW (Sputnik) - The militarization of Europe and bellicose rhetoric directed at CSTO member states are extremely dangerous given the countries' vast military arsenals, especially amid mutual mistrust, CSTO Secretary General Taalatbek Masadykov told Sputnik.
